name: 🔎 Literature Search Ingest
description: Guided literature discovery, user-approved single-paper research delegation, metadata and public-PDF curation, and serial Zotero ingest through zotero-bridge.

prompts.common: 执行 literature-search-ingest。输入：query={{ parameter.query }}，searchMode={{ parameter.searchMode }}，searchBreadth={{ parameter.searchBreadth }}，languageHints={{ parameter.languageHints }}，targetCollection={{ parameter.targetCollection }}。从 runtime/input.json 读取完整参数，遵循 SKILL.md 及其 references 中的阶段完成条件；完成或取消时，只返回 SKILL.md 和 assets/output.schema.json 定义的最终 JSON。
